evidence.quote: Meld je aan voor de opleiding via Studielink.

notes: The intake deadline quote says 'May 1st' without a year; the task-format year 2026 was written because the Avans pages describe the 2026-2027 academic year, but the quote itself does not state a year — an auditor should verify whether the deadline should be recurringDeadline {"month":5,"day":1} instead of a dated 2026-05-01. The programme's own page does not state an international tuition fee; the €10,308 institutional fee is the general Avans non-EEA figure and the separate recommendation deadline (15 June payment) and application deadline (1 May) are general Avans non-EEA rules, not programme-specific. The accountancy page lists only Dutch prior-education entry requirements (havo/vwo profiles, mbo-4) and no English/French language or document requirements for a Moroccan Baccalauréat applicant.
